Where to go in Switzerland

All 10 destinations →

Zürich · Canton of Zurich

Zurich

Riverside Old Town guild houses, Lake Zurich swim clubs, world-class art museums and alpine day-trip rail hub.

Luzern · Canton of Lucerne

Lucerne

Timber Chapel Bridge, frescoed Old Town squares, Lake Lucerne paddle steamers and Mount Pilatus & Rigi.

Berner Oberland · Canton of Bern

Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region

Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau peaks, Lauterbrunnen's 72 waterfalls, Wengen, Mürren and Lake Thun & Brienz.

Zermatt · Canton of Valais

Zermatt & The Matterhorn

Car-free alpine village beneath the iconic Matterhorn pyramid, Gornergrat cogwheel railway and glacier trails.

Bern · Canton of Bern

Bern

UNESCO sandstone arcades, medieval Zytglogge astronomical clock, Rose Garden views and Aare river swims.

Genève · Canton of Geneva

Geneva

Jet d'Eau fountain, UN district, CERN Science Gateway, Vieille Ville and Lake Geneva cruises.

Riviera Vaudoise · Canton of Vaud

Lausanne, Montreux & Lavaux

Château de Chillon, UNESCO terraced Lavaux vineyards, Olympic Museum and GoldenPass Express.

St. Moritz · Canton of Graubünden

St. Moritz & Engadin Valley

High-alpine lakes, Bernina & Glacier Express UNESCO rail lines, sgraffito villages and sunny trails.

How we write our guides

Practical first

We focus on the questions visitors actually face: which ticket to buy, how to get from the airport, what to do when a restaurant has a ticket machine.

Sources you can check

Entry rules, rail passes and prices change. Each guide links to the official source (JNTO, Switzerland Railways, immigration and local tourism boards).

No invented reviews

We don't publish fake testimonials or made-up statistics. Prices are rough ranges meant to help you plan, not quotes.
